name: Old Fisher Yan

personality.speech_style: Slow, salt-cured sentences that circle back to the river.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Cuts your line and lets the current take the rest.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Offers tea, weather talk, and careful half-truths.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Tells you which bends of the river hide what.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Trusts you with the pavilion's quiet errands.

morality_reaction.righteous: Approves, mostly, and asks you to mind the fish.
morality_reaction.neutral: Judges you the way he judges weather: wait and see.
morality_reaction.demonic: Watches the water between you and his boat.

intro_text: The old fisher squares his line without looking up. 'River's chatty today. Sit if you like; it talks more to two.'
repeat_text: 'Back again. The river must like you — or owe you.'

name: Wharf Captain Bao

relationship_behavior.hostile: Bans you from the wharf and charges you anyway.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Nods you past the pilings and quotes loading fees.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Tips you off before the fog rolls in wrong.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Gives you a wharf token even the pirates respect.

morality_reaction.righteous: Grumbles that good men make expensive cargo.
morality_reaction.neutral: Counts you cargo until proven otherwise.
morality_reaction.demonic: Priced your trouble into every quote already.

intro_text: A barrel-chested captain cracks his knuckles by the mooring posts. 'Wharf rules: fight on the sand, not the deck.'
repeat_text: 'Sand's still there if you still want the lesson.'

name: Elder Shan of the Mistwood

personality.speech_style: Trail-wise fragments; names what matters and nothing else.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Trails you for a day before letting you see her.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Shares the trail and the shade, little else.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Walks you past the thorn lines to the good water.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Names you a friend of the wood and means it.

morality_reaction.righteous: Approves of discipline, whatever its creed.
morality_reaction.neutral: Weighs your habits more than your vows.
morality_reaction.demonic: Tolerates the wolf-blood, never the waste.

intro_text: A grey-cloaked elder steps from the thorns as if the thorns stepped aside for her. 'You walk loud. Spar, and I'll show you why.'
repeat_text: 'The wood remembers loud guests. Show it better.'

name: Drift Broker Lan

personality.speech_style: Warm market patter that never quite names a price.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Your credit dies quietly in three markets.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Finds you anything, for a finder's fee.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Holds stock aside and rounds the fee down.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Tells you what the valley sects are really buying.

morality_reaction.righteous: Adjusts the patter; honest folk overpay happily.
morality_reaction.neutral: Business is business, in any band.
morality_reaction.demonic: Demonic coin spends the same, kept off the books.

intro_text: The broker spreads a pelt across the counter like a map. 'Deepwood discourages the idle. What are you, and what do you carry?'

name: Gambler King Tan

personality.speech_style: Odds, wagers, and challenges dressed as compliments.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Stakes against you in every market in the valleys.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Offers you a slip: win, and it's yours.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Backs your wagers with the house's money.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Stakes his own name against your enemies.

morality_reaction.righteous: Righteous marks bet predictably; he says so kindly.
morality_reaction.neutral: Perfect. A coin with two unknown faces.
morality_reaction.demonic: Finds your stakes adorable and your threats boring.

intro_text: The Gambler King fans a handful of technique slips. 'Everything here is for sale or for stakes. Which are you good at?'
repeat_text: 'The table remembers you. The odds have not changed.'

name: Pearl Mistress Sui

personality.speech_style: Measured tide-speech; long silences doing half the talking.

relationship_behavior.hostile: The routes close to you, and the tide knows why.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Grants you the pavilion's shade and its going rates.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Shares the deep lanes and the safe anchors.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Names you warden-friend of every route she keeps.

morality_reaction.righteous: Approves; the righteous guard better than they preach.
morality_reaction.demonic: Demonic patrons pay well and break less, oddly.

intro_text: The Pearl Mistress looks up from a shell of black pearls. 'The tide brought you to my pavilion. That makes you either cargo or guest. Choose.'
repeat_text: 'The pavilion keeps its doors, and its memory, open.'

name: Tide King Hei

personality.speech_style: Roaring toasts that end in threats.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Puts your bounty on the bonfire board by nightfall.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Pours you a cup and names a price for everything.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Grants you cove rights and a pirate's farewell.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Sails beside you, which is a pirate's whole soul.

morality_reaction.righteous: Righteous fools sink the same; he toasts them anyway.
morality_reaction.demonic: Kin, near enough. Blood counts as coin here.

intro_text: The Tide King kicks a chest of salvage toward you. 'Cove rules, guest: fight me, drink with me, or pay harbor weight. Pick fast.'
repeat_text: 'Ha! The tide spat you back. The offer stands.'

name: Forge Master Yan Huo

likes: ore with no lies in it

relationship_behavior.hostile: Your commissions cool in the queue forever.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Names his price and his week; take both or neither.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Quenches your steel with the good well-water.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Forges for you what he would forge for himself.

morality_reaction.righteous: Good causes still pay the same heat rates.
morality_reaction.neutral: Steel holds no creed; neither does the master.
morality_reaction.demonic: Demonic gold spends. The forge does not judge.

intro_text: The Forge Master pulls a blade from the coals with bare fingers. 'Steel first. Talk after. What brings heat to my floor?'
repeat_text: 'The coals remember every hand. Yours held.'

name: War Pavilion Envoy Ru

personality.speech_style: Courtly Asura courtesy over quiet contempt.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Files your name under future campaigns.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Extends the pavilion's terms; declines to explain them.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Shares campaign maps and their terrible margins.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Counts you among the pavilion's proved blades.

morality_reaction.righteous: Righteous enemies die slowest; she keeps them last.
morality_reaction.demonic: The pavilion was built by your kind. Welcome home.

intro_text: The Envoy sets a war-banner beside the dueling ring. 'The pavilion bids for blades. Prove yours, or sign the ledger. Either opens doors.'
repeat_text: 'The banner still stands. So does the offer.'

name: Nameless Zen Wanderer

personality.speech_style: Rare, simple sentences that land like temple bells.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Is simply elsewhere when you arrive.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Makes room on the shrine step for one more cup.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Sweeps your section of the path too.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Answers the question you did not know to ask.

morality_reaction.righteous: Bows to the vow and to the burden alike.
morality_reaction.demonic: Sees the storm and the house it shelters.

intro_text: A ragged wanderer sweeps leaves that keep falling. 'Sit. The mountain does nothing, and everything happens.'
repeat_text: 'You came back. Most do, eventually. Tea is ready.'

name: Rune Temple Warden

personality.speech_style: Litany cadence; measures everything against the circuit.

relationship_behavior.hostile: The undercroft's runes rearrange to unmake you.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Names the trial and waits for your answer.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Grants passage at the lesser wards.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Opens the deep halls and the order's true name.

morality_reaction.righteous: Righteousness is one element among five.
morality_reaction.neutral: The circuit does not weigh hearts, only steps.
morality_reaction.demonic: Blood taints the runes. Expect the harder trial.

intro_text: A figure of banded stone and lit runes descends the stair. 'The circuit turns beneath you. Be tested, or be turned away.'
repeat_text: 'The circuit remembers your step. It has not closed.'

name: Gate Stair Hermit

personality.speech_style: Starfield metaphors; never answers the asked question.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Rearranges the stair so you climb forever.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Points upward and keeps his own counsel.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Walks a landing with you, saying little.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Tells you what the gate takes, and what it returns.

morality_reaction.righteous: Even the righteous stop halfway. He waits.
morality_reaction.neutral: The stair weighs feet, not faith.
morality_reaction.demonic: The gate accepts all blood. It returns none.

intro_text: The hermit sits mid-stair, counting stars that are not there. 'Closer now. The last step costs more than the first thousand.'
repeat_text: 'Still climbing. The stair approves, in its way.'
